name: wz_local
description: Local development and personal tooling projects for the WZ workspace. These are real running instances — not generic or reusable by default. wz_local is the sandbox where new WZ projects are built and proven before they are promoted to wz_systems.

subprojects.name: wztrack
subprojects.description: WZTrack project management tool — the first WZ local instance. Tracks requirements, issues, wiki, test runs, and UAT for all WZ projects.
